subject: [PATCH v3 06/18] selftests/mm: move is_backed_by_folio() into vm_util

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch moves a function called `is_backed_by_folio()` from the `split_huge_page_test.c` file to a new location in the kernel source code, specifically into a utility file called `vm_util.c`. The function checks whether an address range is backed by a folio of a given order. This change allows other tests to use this function and makes it easier to maintain and reuse this functionality across different test cases. No functional changes are made as a result of this patch.
